purpose: Score table detection, row association, and visible stock values in an embedded inventory screenshot from an active Vietnamese seller guide.
reference_method: One reviewer visually transcribed the two visible product rows and headers from a 4x render of page 11. Values and selected OCR text anchors were read from the source image, not OCR output; no independent review has been performed.
limitations: The source is a 2019 Shopee Vietnam PowerPoint-exported PDF with an embedded low-resolution UI screenshot, not a physical scan.
Only two displayed product rows are labeled; this does not establish complete table extraction or general OCR accuracy.
The reference is single-reviewer and unadjudicated; it is exploratory evidence only.
The guide applies to Shopee sellers and is not policy or operating data for the synthetic Commerce dataset.

table_columns: Mã sản phẩm / Thông tin phân loại

table_rows.label: Set quần áo cực chất - test
